title: Rust lichen-gateway: bounded LRU capability table (256, 25% egress reservation)
description: Smallest child of 7nnl (b7z9.36(b)). Pure data-structure slice: a capability table keyed by announcer IID (8 bytes) with capacity 256, LRU eviction, and the spec 8.12 'MAY reserve 25 percent for egress' partition (64 slots reserved for egress-path entries; eviction of mesh-learned entries must not consume the reserved partition — read spec/06-security.md:949-1008 for the exact reservation semantics before implementing). Stored per entry: capability payload bytes, sequence number, expiry. no_std-friendly (heapless or bounded Vec per lichen-gateway conventions). Unit tests: insert/lookup/update-refresh ordering, LRU eviction order, reservation partition behavior, capacity bounds. Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-7nnl.
close_reason: Capability table landed (commit 769994642d, rust/lichen-gateway/src/capability.rs + lib.rs registration): 256-capacity LRU keyed by announcer IID per spec/06-security.md 8.12:949-1008, with the 25% egress-reserved partition (CAPABILITY_RESERVED=64): non-egress insertions occupy at most capacity-64 slots and never evict egress entries; egress insertions evict LRU overall; existing-IID insert refreshes in place; lookup refreshes LRU position; cached_seq exposes the replay-check sequence. Entry fields per the spec table: iid/capabilities/prefix/prefix_len/expiry_unix/seq; egress = capability bit 0. Partition invariant enforced across refreshes too: a refresh that clears the egress bit is rejected when the regular partition is full (previous announcement preserved) — found by review pass 2 and pinned by test refresh_clearing_egress_bit_rejected_when_regular_full. Tests (4): LRU eviction order with refresh, reserved-partition protection under non-egress flooding (64-slot boundary verified), egress in-place update + cached_seq, refresh-guard. Verification: lichen-gateway lib 230 passed / 0 failed, clippy clean on the new module (pre-existing gateway.rs:1528 manual_checked_ops is the only -D warning, untouched), fmt clean. Codereview 3x delegated to kimi-k3: pass 2 found the refresh-partition invariant gap (fixed + pinned); pass 3 cleared tick-overflow and HashMap-iteration-nondeterminism concerns (unique ticks make eviction deterministic); spec validation steps 1-9 deliberately deferred to sibling 7nnl.2 (COSE decode + Schnorr48 verify) and dispatch to 7nnl.3.
